ledger.note: 5600 BCE: the first farmers of the Nile valley settle the shore of the Faiyum lake. "The Faiyum A industry is the earliest farming culture in the Nile Valley"; "Dating to about 5600-4400 BC of the Faiyum Neolithic".

region.text: Merimde Beni Salama, "located in the West delta of the Nile in Lower Egypt 45 km northwest of Cairo", a settlement of "at least 40 hectares"

ledger.note: 5000 BCE: the Merimde villagers settle the western Delta. "From about 5000 to 4200 BC the Merimde culture"; the Merimde page: "It is estimated that the culture evolved between 4800 and 4300 BC", "45 km northwest of Cairo", with "strong connections to the Faiyum A culture as well as the Levant".

region.text: the Faiyum depression around Lake Qarun: "Dating to about 5600-4400 BC of the Faiyum Neolithic"; "The Faiyum A industry is the earliest farming culture in the Nile Valley"

ledger.note: 4400 BCE: the Faiyum Neolithic ends. "Dating to about 5600-4400 BC of the Faiyum Neolithic"; the page does not say how; the depression is nobody's land until the Maadian "emerged from the earliest Neolithic sites of the Nile Valley, in the Faiyum region" (Maadi page).

region.text: Merimde Beni Salama, "located in the West delta of the Nile in Lower Egypt 45 km northwest of Cairo", a settlement of "at least 40 hectares"

ledger.note: 4200 BCE: Merimde is abandoned. "From about 5000 to 4200 BC the Merimde culture" (the Merimde page ends it c. 4300 BC); "In the time of the Maadi-Buto culture, the place was used as a cemetery". Lower Egypt has no culture on the map until the Maadian c. 3800 BCE.

certainty.note: An archaeological culture: the Faiyum depression and one radius in the western Delta, never a frontier.

notes: One dossier for the Lower Egyptian Neolithic (Faiyum A and Merimde), as the brief groups them. The Faiyum A title redirects to Prehistoric Egypt, whose dates (Faiyum 5600-4400, Merimde 5000-4200 BC) are used; the Merimde page gives 4800-4300 BC. El Omari (c. 4600-4400 BC) is on neither page and is not drawn. Lower Egypt is blank from 4200 BCE to the Maadian c. 3800 BCE (gap: page silent). Gazetteer: Merimde Beni Salama, Kom W, Kom K are not places; a coordinate radius (30.84 E, 30.32 N) and the Fayyum region stand in.
